scope: retrospective inventory of retained final-delivery Lean trace/object bytes; not a rebuild, kernel replay, Lake-output consistency check, or execution-time import log
collection_condition: Root confirmed no proof-workspace rebuild or proof-source edit since authorization; captured before remediation proof runs. Existing review probes/stale traces outside the final run module list are excluded.
procedure: Read the final run module list; read each matching Lake trace and its .olean/.olean.server/.olean.private files; hash the bytes without loading Lean or changing the workspace. Compile workspace comes from the retained compile command; it identifies a recorded origin, not an attested build.
